# Opplevagent — portal answer sheet

Every step of the developer portal at https://claude.ai/directory/manage (**Submit new** → **MCP connector**), answered. Copy the fenced blocks as they are. Steps as listed in https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/submission (read 2026-10-17).

Before you start: Ready to submit: no (1 waiting). See the prerequisites in ../README.md.

## 1. Connection

| Field | Answer |
|---|---|
| Server URL | `https://opplevagent.no/mcp` |
| Users connect to different URLs | No |
| Transport | Streamable HTTP, with sessions |
| Protocol versions (MCP SDK) | `2025-11-25`, `2025-06-18`, `2025-03-26`, `2024-11-05`, `2024-10-07` |

The client must send `initialize` first. A request without a live session gets 404, as the MCP spec says; Claude's client does this correctly.

## 2. Tools

**5 tools: 4 read-only, 1 write (1 marked destructive).** The portal syncs them from the server and groups them by read-only and write.

### Read-only (4)

| Tool | `title` | `annotations.title` | readOnlyHint | destructiveHint | openWorldHint | What it does (first sentence) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `discover_experiences` | Discover Norwegian experiences | (same) | true | false | false | Search the opplevagent.no curated marketplace of Norwegian experiences and activities. |
| `list_experience_categories` | List Norwegian experience categories | List experience categories | true | false | false | List all experience categories available on opplevagent.no, along with the number of verified experiences in each category. |
| `get_experience` | Get full details for a Norwegian experience | Get experience details | true | false | false | Fetch complete details for a single experience from opplevagent.no by its UUID. |
| `discover_gardssalg` | Discover Norwegian farm-sale drink producers (gårdssalg) | Discover gårdssalg producers | true | false | false | Search opplevagent.no's gårdssalg (farm-sale) vertical — Brreg-registered Norwegian drink producers (bryggeri/cideri/vingård/destilleri/gårdskafé/mjød/seltzeri) selling directly from the farm. |

### Write (1)

| Tool | `title` | `annotations.title` | readOnlyHint | destructiveHint | openWorldHint | What it does (first sentence) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `book_gardssalg` | Request a gårdssalg booking (pending — email confirmation required) | Request a gårdssalg booking | false | true | true | Submit a booking REQUEST for a Norwegian gårdssalg (farm-sale) producer discovered via discover_gardssalg. |

What each write tool really does:

- `book_gardssalg`: Sends a real visit request by e-mail to the producer, and a status link to the guest. It never confirms a booking: the producer answers. Only producers with live booking can be booked. No payment.

**Two title fields.** 4 of 5 tools have an `annotations.title` that differs from the top-level `title` (`list_experience_categories`, `get_experience`, `discover_gardssalg`, `book_gardssalg`). Both are shown above; which one a client displays depends on the client.

See `listing.md` in this folder. Slug: `opplevagent` (permanent once published).

## 4. Use cases

Primary use cases:

- Plan what to do on a trip in Norway by place, season and weather.
- Find family-friendly or group activities within a budget.
- Find wildlife, outdoor, cultural and food experiences.
- Find breweries, cideries and other farm-sale drink producers near a place, and request a visit.

| Field | Answer |
|---|---|
| What users need before they can connect | Nothing: no account, plan or setup. The server is public and has no sign-in. |
| Reads, writes or both | Both (4 read-only tools, 1 write tools) |

## 6. Authentication

**No authentication.** Paste if the portal asks why:

```
The server serves public data about experiences and farm-sale producers in Norway. There are no user accounts, so there is nothing to sign in to. The one write tool sends a visit request with the guest's own name and e-mail so the producer can answer; it takes no credentials and no payment details.
```

## 7. Data handling

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Whose API is behind the connector | Our own: the server reads Opplevagent's own experience and gårdssalg catalogue on the same domain. |
| Personal health data | No. The connector serves experience and producer data and asks for no health information. |
| Sponsored content | No. The tools return no ads or paid placements. |

Paste if the portal asks what data the connector handles:

```
The tools receive only what a question needs: a search text, a place, filters or coordinates. A visit request (book_gardssalg) passes the guest's name and e-mail, and an optional phone number and note, to the producer so the producer can answer.

There are no accounts, no login credentials and no payment data. The server logs which tool was called and by which client, with a hashed IP address, for usage statistics.

Privacy policy: https://opplevagent.no/personvern
```

## 9. Compliance

Seven acknowledgments, all required. Our basis for each:

| Acknowledgment | Basis |
|---|---|
| Directory guidelines | Read the Software Directory Terms (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13145338-anthropic-software-directory-terms) and Policy (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13145358-anthropic-software-directory-policy). Tick when every prerequisite in ../README.md is done. |
| First-party API usage | Our own: the server reads Opplevagent's own experience and gårdssalg catalogue on the same domain. |
| Financial transactions | No money moves through the connector. Experiences are booked and paid with the provider; a gårdssalg visit is paid on arrival. No card or bank details are asked for. |
| AI media generation | None: the connector generates no images, video or audio. |
| Prompt injection | Tool descriptions say what each tool does and do not instruct Claude (checked against the directive patterns in scripts/gen-connector-packs.ts). |
| Conversation data collection | The tools take only the arguments they need. The server never asks for chat history, memory or files. |
| Public documentation | https://opplevagent.no/guide-opplevelser-mcp |
